svg.title: PDF to markdown pipelines
svg.desc: Mistral and Z.ai use native OCR. OpenAI/Codex and SuperGrok send the original PDF in one vision request, then crop figure regions locally from estimated boxes. That vision path does not split pages; context overflow or timeout fails the whole conversion.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One MCP tool, two pipelines. Image bytes are written to disk; they are never returned as base64.
